justification: Option 1 was not adopted because routing the Viewer through the registry cannot be proven behaviour-neutral in this stage. The provider applies its own dplyr::filter pushdown and collects a single case; the registry accessor returns either a full lazy dataset or a materialised frame. Rewiring it would change the collection point of a page that currently works and is already validated in V6.18.
notes: The registry now KNOWS the artifact, which is what protects a future Parquet-only migration. The provider keeps its lazy read.

justification: Same reasoning as the Viewer provider. The Forecast page passed V6.18 and V6.20 validation with its current lazy read; changing the loading contract was not necessary to close the V6.20 blocker.
Accuracy is the page this stage migrates, so it was wired through the registry from the start. It is the proof that the registry parquet path works end to end.
notes: Cached in .acc_env so the collect happens once per session.

option_chosen: MIXED: Option 1 for Accuracy, Option 2 for Viewer and Forecast
justification: Recorded explicitly rather than decided silently, as required. Two loading contracts persist for the two productive artifacts, and that is a known, documented cost.
notes: Revisit when the Parquet-only migration is executed; at that point Option 1 for all three providers becomes cheap because the registry already resolves the paths.
